problem: Does the real a=0 boundary supply a nonzero native preparation once a positive reference projector is supplied?
obligation: forward realization and noncollapse, upstream of normalized state and readout
source_operation: Original evaluate_sector and four_open_value on all 12 labelled spanning trees and all 243 full-handle sector words; only Metric/Open edge actions, hence no Laurent division
stratum: Unlocalized polynomial tree stage, restricted to real Lorentzian collinear nonzero p_i,k_i and nonzero external q_i=p_i-k_i, with all seven external/test polarizations transverse to their momenta. Not a specialization homomorphism from the localized chart.
conjecture: Every raw sector, hence each full four-open physical tensor, is zero. A supplied positive projector cannot turn this tensor into a nonzero normalized preparation.
rivals: The positive boundary projector alone restores a nonzero source state
Vanishing appears only after cancelling or forgetting marked sector contributions
The probe deletes the source or returns zero on every input
A zero polynomial boundary value refutes complex Ward algebra or fixes every reconstructed/regulated scattering limit

predictions.generic_control: At least one exact generic Gram-free native tree value is nonzero under the declared deterministic valuation
predictions.failure_control: Attempting to normalize the zero amplitude must raise rather than fabricate a density
predictions.positive_control: The explicitly supplied nonzero amplitude (1,0,0,1) has positive squared norm; this is not a native physical preparation

contrast_without_realization: Also record the a=0-only formal source specialization without imposing the extra cross-transversality forced by real collinearity. A nonzero value distinguishes a=0 from the physical real boundary; zero values alone prove no extra general theorem.
native_harness: A dependency-free Cargo package includes the original Rust implementation with only //! documentation lines converted to // for inclusion. Original main is not invoked. Actual source and harness compilation inputs are fingerprinted.
falsifier: Any nonzero boundary sector or tree rejects the conjecture. Zero generic controls reject the nonvacuity test. A source/input mismatch or failed gate invalidates the receipt, not the scientific conjecture.
scope: This is the specified polynomial Yang-Mills marked-theta tensor, not a full massive-electron QED amplitude. No physical rates, new probability law, analytic reconstruction, wave-packet/regulator limit, colimit theorem or apparatus calibration is established. Zero-momentum external ports and singular completions require separately supplied definitions.
